optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Product Analyst, Low-Code Application Platform

professionalSummary.text: Experienced Data Product Analyst with a proven track record of defining, maintaining, and communicating key platform metrics for a low‑code application environment.
professionalSummary.witness: Defined the platform's weekly active builders, app publish rate and app error‑rate metrics in the analytics warehouse (dbt models on BigQuery) and maintained the metric definitions page.

experienceHighlights.text: Defined and maintained core usage and reliability metrics in the analytics warehouse, ensuring accurate data for stakeholders.
experienceHighlights.witness: Defined the platform's weekly active builders, app publish rate and app error‑rate metrics in the analytics warehouse (dbt models on BigQuery) and maintained the metric definitions page.

experienceHighlights.text: Investigated a significant April drop in app publish rate, identified a permission change as the root cause, and documented the resolution.
experienceHighlights.witness: Investigated the April drop in app publish rate with the platform team, traced it to a permission change in the publishing service and documented the cause and the fix in the analytics incident log.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented structured findings to product management monthly and to customer success quarterly, using a standardized deck that highlighted trends, causes, and recommended actions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented monthly findings to product management and quarterly findings to the customer success team, using a standard deck with metric trend, cause and recommended follow‑up for each anomaly.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated metric definition changes with platform and data engineering teams, documenting ownership and responsibilities throughout the data change process.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated metric definition changes with the platform and data engineering teams through the data change process, recording my ownership of the definitions and data engineering's ownership of the pipelines.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented metric definitions, known limitations, and hand‑over conditions for each change, ensuring clear traceability and accountability.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated metric definition changes with the platform and data engineering teams through the data change process, recording my ownership of the definitions and data engineering's ownership of the pipelines.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a work sample of the metric definitions page export and the April anomaly investigation write‑up, including verification queries and warehouse query history.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the metric definitions page export and the April anomaly investigation write‑up (timeline, cause, fix, verification query), with the warehouse query history as a verification trail.

skills.text: dbt, BigQuery, analytics warehouse, metric definition, anomaly investigation, stakeholder communication, data change management
